info.name: HRMS Platform — Complete API Collection
info.description:
End-to-end Postman collection for the HRMS Platform API. Base URL: http://localhost:3000/api/v1

Setup:
1. Run 'Login' request — the pre-request script stores accessToken, refreshToken, and tenantId automatically.
2. All subsequent requests use {{accessToken}} and {{tenantId}} from collection variables.

Default admin credentials: admin@hrms.com / Admin@123

request.description: Login and get access token. Save accessToken and tenantId from response.
